title: mcp-remote executes attacker commands when connecting to an untrusted MCP server
summary: mcp-remote, the npm proxy that lets local MCP clients reach remote servers, passed the authorization_endpoint URL returned by the server into an OS command without sanitising it. A malicious or hijacked MCP server could therefore run arbitrary commands on the connecting machine; versions 0.0.5 through 0.1.15 are affected.
severity_rationale: CVSS 9.6 remote code execution triggered by nothing more than pointing a client at an attacker-run MCP server.
